description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402] Resolves an ENS name (e.g. vitalik.eth) to its Ethereum address, or an address to its primary ENS name, read live from Ethereum mainnet. Give exactly one of name or address. A reverse result is returned only if that name resolves back to the same address (otherwise it is reported as unverified, never as the answer). Names are normalized (ENSIP-15) first; a name that cannot be normalized is refused.
name: ens_resolve
title: ENS name to address, or address to ENS name
